prompt: A very long telephoto lens looking straight up a British motorway from a footbridge: a shanty town of tarps, pallet huts and tents fills every lane for miles, compressed into one dense wall climbing a hill to the horizon, people in heavy coats walking down the central reservation carrying water containers, a dead gantry overhead. Flat grey overcast winter daylight in a near-future Britain, muted cold colour, drizzle in the air; photographed like a feature film on 35mm stock: fine grain, deep shadows that stay dark, no lens flare, no bloom, no teal-orange grade. 16:9. No writing anywhere in the frame: no signs, banners, logos, number plates or screen text. No children.
